question.text: On the expiry day, trading in the expiring currency futures contract ceases at:

explanation.text: The Logic: On the expiry day, trading in the expiring currency futures contract ceases at 12:30 PM rather than the regular 5:00 PM (INR pairs) or 7:30 PM (cross-currency pairs) close. The Trap: 5:00 PM, 3:30 PM, and 7:30 PM are regular trading-day closes for various segments — they are not the expiring-contract cut-off. Note: Only the expiring contract closes at 12:30 PM on expiry day; other (non-expiring) contracts continue trading to the normal close.
